description: The documented worker timeout matches the 45-second requirement, but the acceptance test was not run. RealityCheck should identify the verification gap without inventing a configuration mismatch or claiming the behavior failed.

documents.text: R-010: Document extraction shall have a hard processing timeout of 45 seconds per file. A timeout shall result in a terminal failed job state and a user-readable error.

PDF extraction runs in a worker process. The worker timeout is configured to 45 seconds. If the worker times out, the job manager records a terminal failed state and displays the message: 'Document processing exceeded the 45-second limit. Please try a smaller file.'
OBS-010: The slow-extraction acceptance fixture has not been run. No runtime observation is available to confirm the timeout, terminal state, or user-visible error behavior.
